sentences.text: Social worker Hannah Price spoke with Stacey Lambert and Millie Lambert on Tuesday 24 November 2026.
School contacted social services because Millie told her teacher she did not want to go home on Monday.
Stacey Lambert stated Millie has been 'funny lately' due to bedwetting and embarrassment.
Household members present: Stacey Lambert (mother), Millie Lambert (child, aged 9), Craig (stepfather), and Jayden (child, aged 2).
Craig is Millie's stepfather; the couple has been together for four years.
Millie's biological father is in Scotland; Millie sees him during summer holidays.
Millie has a hamster named Biscuit which is currently asleep.
The landlord is slow to fix damp in Millie's room.
Millie is in Year Four and plays in the netball team at school.
Millie stated Jayden takes her pens.
Stacey Lambert stated the bedwetting washing is 'endless'.
Stacey Lambert stated she thought Millie would grow out of the bedwetting.
Millie stated she did not want to go home on Monday because of the bed.
Millie disclosed that when she wets the bed, Craig gets cross and hits her with a belt.
Millie stated Craig hits her on her legs and the back of her legs.
Millie stated the hitting happens 'lots', like every week, every time she wets the bed.
Millie stated the last incident happened on Sunday morning before Mum got up.
Millie stated the hitting left red lines which went away.
Millie stated no one else at home hurts her.
Millie stated her mum never hits her and gives her cuddles.
Stacey Lambert denied that Craig's actions constitute abuse, stating it is 'just a smack' and 'not hard'.
Stacey Lambert stated she has seen Craig hit Millie 'once or twice'.
Stacey Lambert stated Craig is from a strict family and she has told him to stop.
Social worker Hannah Price stated that hitting a child with a belt is not acceptable and she must act on it.
Social worker Hannah Price stated she is going to speak to her manager and the police today for a strategy discussion.
Social worker Hannah Price stated she needs Millie to be safe tonight and asked if Craig could stay elsewhere.
Stacey Lambert offered to keep Craig at his brother's on Canal Street until further notice.
Stacey Lambert works mornings at Greggs; Craig works full time on the bins.
Stacey Lambert agreed to ring Craig to have him stay at his brother's on Canal Street tonight.
Social worker Hannah Price stated she will ring her manager and the police when she leaves and call Stacey by five today.
Social worker Hannah Price stated she will speak to Mrs Hollis at school tomorrow morning and ask the school nurse to refer Millie to the clinic.
Social worker Hannah Price stated she will write to the landlord about the damp by Friday.
Social worker Hannah Price stated she will visit again on Thursday the twenty-sixth.
